pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Kansas GPA

officialLinks.label: Grade points, GPA formula, plus/minus, exclusions

helpIntro: KU uses a 4.0 credit-hour GPA. Enter KU credit hours and grades; A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0, with ±0.3 intermediate grades where adopted.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate KU GPA planning. CR/NC, S/U, I and W are excluded. Repeat Impact is disabled because eligible KU repeats use the higher grade and have policy limits.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points; a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Together, 21.9 ÷ 6 = 3.65.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 points where plus/minus grading is used.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 points; attempted graded hours remain in the GPA unless an approved policy changes the record.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; no grade points until resolved.
gradeExplanations.SP: Satisfactory Progress for thesis/dissertation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.LP: Limited Progress for thesis/dissertation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: No Progress for thesis/dissertation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.M: Mastered competency notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NM: Not Mastered competency notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress competency notation; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.+: Credit awarded by exam/experience/training; not a plus letter grade and excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: KU course, standard letter grading
specialTypes.note: Use the grade shown on the KU record. Plus/minus values apply where the school or College uses them.

specialTypes.name: KU non-GPA grading (CR/NC, S/U, progress/competency)
specialTypes.note: Select the actual notation; excluded marks add no GPA points or GPA hours.

specialTypes.name: External transfer coursework
specialTypes.note: Transfer GPA is a separate admissions/credit concept; external grades do not become KU institutional GPA in this profile.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. KU may exclude inferior eligible attempts and keep the highest grade, so confirm repeat eligibility on your KU record.
